title: Seismology of Glasses
summary: Aging and relaxation of glasses proceed through localized rearrangements that also generate long-ranged mechanical responses in their surroundings. We develop a theory that treats these rearrangements as internal microseismic sources, and thereby separates the direct effects emerging from an event from the effects from the far-field displacements it generates. These far-field disturbances propagate and relax through the viscoelastic medium through which they move, producing a stochastic background of weak but numerous perturbations at any given location. Combining the description of local events from the Random First Order Transition theory with this propagating background, we derive a unified equation for the dynamical structure factor of a relaxing glass. The theory identifies a finite wave-vector and time window in which the growing viscoelastic far-field disturbances can produce compressed exponential relaxation, which has been observed using X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy. At higher wave vectors that resolve local jumps, heterogeneity of the local event dynamics instead produces stretched exponential relaxation. The crossover between these behaviors depends on the event statistics and the scattering phase accumulated across the region reached through viscoelastic propagation from the numerous distant sources.

AI.tldr: 将玻璃老化/弛豫中的局域重排视为内部微震源，并结合远场黏弹性传播与RFOT，推导动态结构因子统一方程，解释压缩/拉伸指数弛豫及其波矢依赖。
AI.motivation: 玻璃弛豫由局域重排驱动，同时产生长程力学响应；需要区分局域事件的直接效应与远场位移传播/弛豫效应，并统一解释XPCS观测到的压缩指数弛豫等现象。
AI.method: 把重排作为内部微震源；分离直接效应与远场位移；远场扰动在黏弹性介质中传播和弛豫，形成随机背景；用RFOT描述局域事件，并与传播背景结合，推导弛豫玻璃动态结构因子的统一方程。
AI.result: 理论识别出有限波矢和时间窗口：增长的黏弹性远场扰动可产生压缩指数弛豫；在高波矢分辨局域跳跃时，局域事件动力学非均匀性产生拉伸指数弛豫；两者交叉取决于事件统计及从众多远源经黏弹性传播区域的累积散射相位。
AI.conclusion: 远场黏弹性传播是玻璃弛豫中压缩指数行为的关键机制；局域事件统计与传播累积相位共同控制从压缩到拉伸指数弛豫的转变，为XPCS观测提供统一理论框架。

title: Resolving Structural Uncertainty in Stochastic Dynamical Systems via Ensemble-Based Bayesian Inference
summary: Recovering the interaction structure of complex stochastic dynamical systems from sparse time-series observations is an inherently ill-posed inverse problem. The posterior over network configurations is high-dimensional, highly degenerate, and shaped by the non-equilibrium nature of the available data. To address this, we propose a fully Bayesian, ensemble-based inference framework. Our approach grounds a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) likelihood formulation---acting mathematically as an Onsager-Machlup quasi-potential for non-equilibrium paths---within a non-parametric Minimum Description Length (MDL) structural prior. This framework rigorously penalizes model complexity and avoids kinetic overfitting by forcing continuous parameters into a finite vocabulary of discrete categories. The joint posterior is optimized using a block-coordinate scheme combining sub-quadratic Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) topological sampling with deterministic Nelder-Mead parameter optimization. Using highly non-linear macroscopic population dynamics as a benchmark, we demonstrate that inference requires non-stationary transient data to resolve causal information. Furthermore, we prove that propagating structural uncertainty via ensemble-based posterior analysis produces significantly more robust and reliable predictions for downstream perturbation outcomes than traditional single-point (MAP) estimates. The framework is highly generalizable, capturing fundamental topological constraints even under severe generative model mismatches, offering a robust tool for uncertainty-aware inference in complex stochastic systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全贝叶斯、基于集成的推断框架，从稀疏时间序列中恢复复杂随机动力系统的交互结构；该方法结合连续时间SDE/Onsager-Machlup似然、MDL结构先验、MCMC拓扑采样与Nelder-Mead参数优化，并利用非平稳瞬态数据传播结构不确定性，优于传统MAP单点估计。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏时间序列观测中恢复复杂随机系统的交互结构本质上是病态逆问题；网络配置后验高维、高度退化，并受数据非平衡特性影响，因此需要既能惩罚复杂度、避免动力学过拟合，又能进行不确定性感知推断的方法。
AI.method: 构建全贝叶斯、基于集成的推断框架：以连续时间随机微分方程（SDE）似然作为非平衡路径的Onsager-Machlup准势，并置于非参数最小描述长度（MDL）结构先验下；通过将连续参数限制到有限离散类别词表来避免动力学过拟合。联合后验采用块坐标优化：亚二次MCMC进行拓扑采样，确定性Nelder-Mead进行参数优化。
AI.result: 以高度非线性的宏观种群动力学为基准，表明推断需要非平稳瞬态数据才能解析因果信息；通过基于集成的后验分析传播结构不确定性，对下游扰动结果的预测显著比传统单点（MAP）估计更稳健、可靠；在严重生成模型失配下仍能捕获基本拓扑约束。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有高度通用性，可为复杂随机系统中的不确定性感知推断提供鲁棒工具，尤其适用于从稀疏、非平衡时间序列中恢复交互结构并支持下游扰动预测。

title: Deep Learning of Phase Transitions for Bilinear-Biquadratic Spin-1 Chains from Correlation Aspects
summary: We investigate the role of different correlation functions in reconstructing the phase diagram of the spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic chain, parametrized by the angle $\theta$ between the bilinear and biquadratic couplings, using our previously developed label-free machine-learning pipeline \cite{Ming21, Ming23}, in which an autoencoder compresses iDMRG correlation matrices into latent features and K-means clustering with silhouette analysis groups them into phases. Without any prior labels, the scheme reveals four natural phases, the Haldane, dimerized, critical trimerized, and ferromagnetic phases, and accurately locates the Takhtajan-Babujian ($\theta=-\pi/4$), $SU(3)$-symmetric Uimin-Lai-Sutherland ($\theta=\pi/4$), and Ferro-Dimer ($\theta=5\pi/4$) transition points; a shallow supervised refinement further sharpens the phase boundaries. We find that different correlation functions play fundamentally different roles in phase identification. The $SU(3)$-symmetric correlation alone selects a four-cluster partition that can be associated with the four phases, whereas the spin-spin and dimer-dimer correlations must be combined to recover the complete phase diagram. In contrast, the trimer-trimer correlation behaves as a marginal correlation: it is insufficient for phase identification by itself but improves the precision of the predicted phase boundaries when combined with the other correlations. Furthermore, the latent representations and silhouette values reveal signatures that we relate to the $\theta$ dependence of the correlations within each phase and, tentatively, to the underlying renormalization-group structure. These results demonstrate that machine learning can not only identify quantum phases but also uncover the physical information encoded in different correlation functions.

AI.tldr: 该工作用无标签机器学习流程研究自旋-1双线性-双二次链的相图重建，发现不同关联函数在相识别中作用不同：SU(3)关联函数可单独给出对应四相的聚类，自旋-自旋与二聚体-二聚体关联函数需结合才能恢复完整相图，三聚体-三聚体关联函数则是边际性关联函数。
AI.motivation: 探究不同关联函数在量子相识别与相图重建中分别扮演什么角色，并检验机器学习能否在无先验标签下揭示这些关联函数所编码的物理信息。
AI.method: 采用作者此前发展的无标签机器学习流程：用iDMRG计算关联矩阵，经自编码器压缩为潜在特征，再用K-means聚类并结合轮廓分析将样本分组为相；无需先验标签，并辅以浅层监督微调以锐化相边界。系统比较SU(3)、自旋-自旋、二聚体-二聚体和三聚体-三聚体等关联函数的作用。
AI.result: 无标签流程自然揭示四个相：Haldane相、二聚化相、临界三聚化相和铁磁相，并准确定位Takhtajan-Babujian（θ=-π/4）、SU(3)对称的Uimin-Lai-Sutherland（θ=π/4）和Ferro-Dimer（θ=5π/4）转变点。SU(3)对称关联函数单独即可选出与四相对应的四簇划分；自旋-自旋与二聚体-二聚体关联函数必须结合才能恢复完整相图；三聚体-三聚体关联函数单独不足以识别相，但与其他关联函数结合可提高相边界预测精度。潜在表示和轮廓值还显示出与各相内关联函数θ依赖相关的特征，并初步联系到重整化群结构。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习不仅能识别量子相，还能揭示不同关联函数中编码的物理信息，表明关联函数的选择与组合对相图重建具有本质影响。

title: Testing Replica Symmetry Breaking in the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson model by using vanishing fields
summary:
Replica Symmetry Breaking (RSB) theory for spin glasses, which is exact in infinite dimensions, provides detailed predictions for the behavior of these systems. One of these predictions is that vanishing magnetic fields induce chaotic behavior. Here, vanishing has a precise meaning: we refer to an externally applied magnetic field with intensity scaling as $1/\sqrt{N}$, where $N$ is the number of spins in the system. RSB predicts that this chaotic behavior depends only on the probability density function of the overlap, $P(q)$, as computed at zero field.
  We proceed to test the RSB prediction in the 3D Edwards-Anderson model, by first computing the $P(q)$ numerically in the absence of a magnetic field. We then use this function as input to analytically compute the statistics of the states in the regime of a vanishing magnetic field, using a representation based on the Bolthausen-Sznitman coalescent process (which is exact for the mean-field Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model). This mixed numerical-analytical approach allows us to determine the prediction of RSB for the overlap distribution function measured in the presence of a small vanishing field, as well as the increase in chaoticity as the field strength grows.
  The above RSB predictions are quantitatively compared with the outcome of numerical simulations of the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson in the presence of a small vanishing field, finding very good agreement. This agreement provides strong support for the idea that three-dimensional spin glass at zero magnetic field and low temperature is well described by RSB theory.

AI.tldr: 该文在三维Edwards-Anderson自旋玻璃模型中检验复本对称破缺（RSB）理论关于消失磁场（强度按1/√N缩放）引发混沌行为的预言。
AI.motivation: RSB理论在无穷维精确，并预言消失磁场会导致自旋玻璃的混沌行为；作者希望验证该预言是否也适用于三维Edwards-Anderson模型。
AI.method: 先数值计算零磁场下的重叠概率密度P(q)，再将其作为输入，采用对平均场Sherrington-Kirkpatrick模型精确的Bolthausen-Sznitman聚结过程表示，解析计算消失磁场下状态统计、重叠分布及随磁场增强的混沌性增长，并与三维Edwards-Anderson模型数值模拟对比。
AI.result: RSB理论对消失磁场下重叠分布和混沌性增强的预言，与三维Edwards-Anderson模型的数值模拟结果高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该一致性有力支持零磁场低温下的三维自旋玻璃可由RSB理论良好描述。

title: Measurement-induced criticality for non-Abelian anyons: The monitored golden chain
summary: Non-Abelian anyon chains whose interactions favor a single fusion channel host quantum critical ground states described by minimal-model conformal field theories (CFTs) protected by a topological symmetry. We show that their measurement-only counterpart, where non-commuting fusion charge measurements act locally on the anyons of a chain of $L$ sites, provides a fundamental example of a non-unitary CFT controlling a non-Abelian learning problem. Mapping the monitored dynamics to a random tensor network, we numerically find $1/L$ scaling Lyapunov gaps, logarithmic entanglement scaling with the chord length, and an effective central charge in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record. The conserved topological charge sharpens with dynamical exponent $z= 1$ and is learnable by a decoder on an $O(L)$ time scale. As the topological symmetry is a non-invertible symmetry of the $SU(2)_k$ anyon theories, we establish the monitored golden chain $(k=3)$ as a non-Abelian generalization of the weakly (Kramers-Wannier) self-dual quantum critical point of the toric code $(k=2)$, and the first of a family for $k\geq 3$.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究非阿贝尔任意子链的测量-only动力学，将其作为受非幺正CFT控制的非阿贝尔学习问题；通过随机张量网络发现1/L Lyapunov gap、对数纠缠增长、Shannon熵有效中心荷以及z=1的可学习拓扑荷，并把k=3 monitored golden chain确立为k=2 toric code弱Kramers-Wannier自对偶临界点的非阿贝尔推广。
AI.motivation: 偏好单一融合通道的非阿贝尔任意子链可承载由拓扑对称性保护、由最小模型CFT描述的量子临界基态。作者希望理解其测量-only对应物：局部非对易融合荷测量如何驱动监控动力学，并是否由非幺正CFT控制，从而给出非阿贝尔学习问题的基本范例。
AI.method: 对L站点任意子链施加局部非对易融合荷测量；将监控动力学映射为随机张量网络；数值提取Lyapunov gap、纠缠标度与测量记录Shannon熵，并分析守恒拓扑荷的动力学及解码器学习行为。
AI.result: 数值得到Lyapunov gap按1/L标度，纠缠随弦长呈对数标度，测量记录Shannon熵具有有效中心荷；守恒拓扑荷以动力学指数z=1锐化，并可在O(L)时间内由解码器学习。k=3 monitored golden chain被确立为k=2 toric code弱Kramers-Wannier自对偶量子临界点的非阿贝尔推广，也是k≥3家族的首例。
AI.conclusion: 测量-only非阿贝尔任意子链提供了由非幺正CFT控制非阿贝尔学习问题的基本例子；monitored golden chain将非阿贝尔临界性与拓扑/不可逆对称性、可学习性联系起来，并推广了toric code的弱自对偶临界点。

title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
summary: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor $\nu = 3/2$. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension $\sqrt{2}$, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.

AI.tldr: 该工作首次在包含全部电子与全部朗道能级、并考虑真实朗道能级混合的条件下，求解了填充因子 ν=3/2 的自旋极化分数量子霍尔问题，发现伊辛型非阿贝尔任意子，并表明朗道能级混合更支持 anti-Pfaffian 态。
AI.motivation: 非阿贝尔任意子是容错拓扑量子计算的基础，预期出现在偶数分母分数量子霍尔态中；但确定具体拓扑序需要精确、非微扰地处理真实朗道能级混合，而此前理论研究缺失这一环节。
AI.method: 作者针对 ν=3/2 自旋极化电子，构建动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，仅基于微观哈密顿量进行优化，从而直接获得拓扑简并基态；未输入预期物理结果或候选态信息。
AI.result: 神经网络变分计算自发发现简并基态流形，其纠缠性质揭示量子维度为 √2 的任意子，即伊辛型非阿贝尔序的特征；进一步通过计算与试探波函数的重叠，证明朗道能级混合使 anti-Pfaffian 比其他候选态更受青睐。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，神经网络波函数能够从第一性原理出发，在强朗道能级混合且与近期实验相关的区域中发现并刻画非阿贝尔任意子。

title: Transmission representation of the Josephson free energy beyond the short-junction limit
summary: Beenakker's formula, $U(\varphi)-U(0)=\Delta\sum_n\bigl(1-\sqrt{1-\tau_n\sin^2(\varphi/2)}\bigr)$, expresses the zero-temperature energy-phase relation of a short Josephson junction through its normal-state transmission eigenvalues. We generalize this transmission representation beyond the short-junction limit and express the phase-dependent free energy of a time-reversal-symmetric $s$-wave junction as a Matsubara sum over channels with frequency-dependent transmissions. The representation constrains the small-phase expansion of the free energy. In particular, we prove that the normalized ratio of its quartic and quadratic coefficients satisfies $-1\le\alpha_r\le7/80$ at finite temperature. We also construct a four-site junction with $\alpha_r>0$, which disproves the conjectured upper bound $\alpha_r\le0$. So that these results can be trusted without repeating the derivations, every numbered equation is formally verified in the Lean proof assistant.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Beenakker 公式从短结、零温情形推广到更一般的透射表示：对时间反演对称的 s 波约瑟夫森结，把相位依赖自由能写成含频率依赖透射通道的 Matsubara 求和，并用该表示约束小相位展开。作者证明有限温度下四次项与二次项系数之比满足 -1≤α_r≤7/80，并构造四站点结得到 α_r>0，从而推翻 α_r≤0 的猜想；所有编号公式均用 Lean 证明助手形式化验证。
AI.motivation: Beenakker 公式仅适用于短结极限和零温，无法直接描述更一般结的自由能相位依赖及非谐响应。本文旨在超越短结极限，建立更普遍的透射表示，并检验小相位展开中四次项与二次项系数比的猜想上界。
AI.method: 针对时间反演对称的 s 波约瑟夫森结，将相位依赖自由能表示为对通道求和的 Matsubara 形式，其中透射系数依赖频率；利用该表示分析小相位展开，推导 α_r 的有限温度约束。进一步构造一个四站点结模型以检验 α_r 的符号。所有编号公式均在 Lean 证明助手中形式化验证。
AI.result: 得到小相位展开的约束，并证明有限温度下归一化比值满足 -1≤α_r≤7/80。构造的四站点结具有 α_r>0，因此 α_r≤0 的猜想上界不成立。
AI.conclusion: 更一般的频率依赖透射 Matsubara 表示能有效约束约瑟夫森结自由能的小相位行为，给出新的 α_r 上下界并否定旧猜想；Lean 形式化验证则保证推导结果无需重复人工演算即可信任。

title: Nanoscale Mapping of Strain-engineered Excitons in Monolayer WSe$_2$
summary: Excitons in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) are highly sensitive to external stimuli, allowing control of resonance energies and lifetimes through electric and magnetic fields, heterostructures, moire potentials and mechanical strain. Observations of single-photon emission (SPE) near sample edges, wrinkles, and strained nanobubbles have motivated strain-engineering aimed at realizing localized emitters in 2D materials. The origin of these emitters remains unclear and prior studies have relied on far-field spectroscopy with strain profiles inferred separately through topography, limiting direct correlation between local strain and excitonic response. We directly probe strain-modified excitonic spectra in monolayer WSe$_2$ using cryogenic scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM). We compare two strain-engineering techniques, nano-indentation and patterned substrates, used to produce SPEs. At 9 K, we spatially resolve exciton resonance shifts with sub-diffraction limit resolution, simultaneously measuring near-field optical response and topography. We observe that strain transferred from nano-indentation into a deformable polymer substrate differs from that produced by draping TMDs over patterned dielectric pillars. Adhesion and tearing during plastic deformation drive a compressive exciton blueshift, while draping produces dominant tensile strain. Comparing the strain model results to the experimentally observed energy shifts shows that the nano-indentation strain is over an order of magnitude smaller than previously inferred, due to puncturing of the fragile monolayer, whereas pillar-strained devices remain intact under more modest strain. These differences suggest SPE arises from complex, strain-mediated interactions rather than simple confinement potentials, establishing s-SNOM as a powerful probe of quantum emission in strained 2D materials.

AI.tldr: 利用低温散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）直接探测单层WSe2中应变调制的激子光谱，比较纳米压痕与图案化衬底两种应变工程，发现二者应变性质与大小显著不同，并修正了纳米压痕应变被高估的问题。
AI.motivation: 单层过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）中的激子对外部刺激高度敏感，边缘、褶皱和应变纳米气泡附近的单光子发射（SPE）起源尚不明确；以往研究依赖远场光谱并通过形貌单独推断应变，难以直接关联局域应变与激子响应。
AI.method: 在9 K下使用s-SNOM对单层WSe2进行亚衍射极限空间分辨测量，同步获得近场光学响应与形貌；比较纳米压痕进入可变形聚合物衬底与将TMD覆盖在图案化介电柱上的两种应变工程方法，并将应变模型结果与实验观测能移对比。
AI.result: 纳米压痕传递到聚合物衬底的应变不同于覆盖图案化介电柱产生的应变：塑性变形中的粘附与撕裂导致压缩应变和激子蓝移，而覆盖介电柱主要产生拉伸应变。与实验能移对比表明，纳米压痕实际应变比先前推断小一个数量级以上，原因是脆弱单层被刺穿；柱应变器件则在较温和应变下保持完整。
AI.conclusion: 这些差异表明SPE源于复杂的应变介导相互作用，而非简单的限域势；s-SNOM是探测应变二维材料中量子发射的有力工具。

title: Topological superconductivity in layered d-wave altermagnetic metals
summary: We investigate multilayer d-wave altermagnetic metals with odd-parity helical p-wave pairing. In the minimal bilayer system, interlayer tunneling reconstructs the spin-split Fermi surfaces and generates two layer-hybridized sectors with distinct effective chemical potentials. Without Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC), the emergent mirror symmetry and subsystem chiral symmetry stabilize phases with different numbers of helical Majorana edge-mode pairs and additional counterpropagating pairs, jointly characterized by the mirror Chern number and the winding numbers defined along high-symmetry lines. The combination of RSOC and the altermagnetic exchange field gaps out the helical Majorana pairs while, in a certain parameter regime, leaving another pair of counterpropagating Majorana edge modes gapless, giving rise to second-order topological phases with isolated or twofold Majorana corner modes, as well as a hybrid-order phase in which gapless Majorana edge modes coexist with Majorana corner modes. We identify a layer symmetry that elucidates the physical origin of these phases. For an arbitrary N-layer system, such a symmetry naturally arises from the interlayer-coupling matrix, allowing N-fold Majorana corner modes to emerge when all layer-hybridized sectors enter the nontrivial second-order regime. Our results establish the interplay among the layer degree of freedom, odd-parity pairing, and Fermi-surface configurations as a controllable route to engineering topological superconductivity in layered altermagnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 该文研究多层d波交替磁性金属中的奇宇称螺旋p波配对，揭示层间杂化、对称性与费米面重构如何产生多种马约拉纳边缘态、角态及高阶/混合阶拓扑超导相。
AI.motivation: 探索层自由度、奇宇称配对和交替磁交换场如何协同调控拓扑超导，并寻找可工程化的马约拉纳模式。
AI.method: 以最小双层系统为起点，引入层间隧穿、d波交替磁序、螺旋p波配对与Rashba自旋轨道耦合，结合镜面对称/子系统手征对称分析，用镜面陈数和高对称线绕数分类相，并推广至任意N层。
AI.result: 无RSOC时，层间杂化产生两个具有不同有效化学势的层杂化分区，稳定不同数量螺旋马约拉纳边缘模对及反向传播模对；加入RSOC和交替磁交换场后，部分螺旋马约拉纳对打开能隙，出现具有孤立或双重马约拉纳角模的二阶拓扑相，以及无能隙马约拉纳边缘模与角模共存的混合阶相；N层系统可实现N重马约拉纳角模。
AI.conclusion: 层间耦合矩阵自然产生的层对称性解释了这些拓扑相的起源；层自由度、奇宇称配对与费米面构型的相互作用为层状交替磁体中的拓扑超导提供了可控设计路线。

title: Cooperative Boundary Switching of Mesoscopic Real Spectra in a Non-Hermitian Chain Family
summary: At fixed bulk criticality, every fixed nonsingular real single-end potential preserves a growing local population of real eigenvalues in an open analytic family of non-Hermitian chains. An open region of two-end real potentials removes this population. A boundary-amplitude criterion fixes the minimum number of controlled ends. The population grows as $\sqrt N$, where $N$ is chain length, although its normalized spectral weight vanishes and the local limiting bands remain unchanged. For a representative chain's four zero-detuning settings, an independent passive Hermitian double chain converts this distinction into separated resonances at one fixed local port under a common coupling scan at fixed probe carrier. Its absolute reflection contrast and stability margin both scale as $N^{-1}$, with explicit sufficient resource budgets. Boundary amplitudes thus fix a minimum control requirement that limiting bands and thermodynamic spectral density do not specify.

AI.tldr: 在固定体临界下，非厄米链的实本征值局域种群由边界条件决定：单端实势可保留随链长 N 按 √N 增长的种群，双端实势可将其移除；边界振幅判据给出所需受控端数下限，并可通过被动厄米双链在固定端口读出为分离共振。
AI.motivation: 传统极限能带和热力学谱密度无法刻画有限非厄米链中由边界势导致的实谱局域种群及其控制需求，因此需要明确边界振幅如何决定最小控制端数。
AI.method: 在开放解析族中比较固定非奇异实单端与双端势对实本征值种群的影响，提出边界振幅判据；并针对代表性链的四个零失谐设置，设计被动厄米双链，在固定局域端口、共同耦合扫描和固定探针载波下将谱差异映射为分离共振，同时给出显式资源预算。
AI.result: 单端实势保持随 N 按 √N 增长的实本征值局域种群，双端实势消除该种群；种群归一化谱权趋于零且局域极限能带不变。被动厄米双链可将该区别转化为固定端口处的分离共振，绝对反射对比度和稳定裕度均按 N^{-1} 缩放，并存在显式充分资源预算。
AI.conclusion: 边界振幅固定了最小控制端数要求，而该要求不能由极限能带或热力学谱密度指定；有限尺寸非厄米谱工程必须考虑边界控制资源。

title: Pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures (Habilitation thesis)
summary:
Tracing my scientific path from many-body physics in semiconductor nanostructures to topological quantum matter, this Habilitation \`a diriger des recherches (HDR) memoir presents only part of my research since defending two PhD theses in Toulouse and Nizhny Novgorod in 2011. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists.
  The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. The second examines pressure-, temperature-, and disorder-driven phase transitions in single and double HgTe quantum wells (QWs), including bilayer-graphene-like semimetals and a two-dimensional higher-order topological insulator (2D HOTI) phase beyond the minimal BHZ model. The third develops three-layer InAs/Ga(In)Sb QWs as a III-V platform for massless Dirac fermions, large-gap quantum spin Hall insulators, 2D HOTI phases, and semimetals with quadratic band touching, and discusses InAs$_{x}$Sb$_{1-x}$/InAs$_{y}$Sb$_{1-y}$ heterostructures as a promising alternative. Several of these predictions are supported by experimental observations, including quantized helical edge transport up to 60 K and the unconventional quantum Hall effect.
  Defended on March 25, 2026, at the University of Montpellier. Jury: Michel GOIRAN (chair and rapporteur, LNCMI-CNRS, Toulouse); Alexey KAVOKIN (rapporteur, Westlake University, Hangzhou); Robson FERREIRA (rapporteur, LPENS-CNRS, Paris); Alexei BARANOV (member, IES-CNRS, Montpellier); Benoit JOUAULT and Fr\'ed\'eric TEPPE (members, L2C-CNRS, Montpellier).

AI.tldr: 该 HDR 回忆录总结作者自2011年两个博士论文答辩以来的部分研究，聚焦闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的赝相对论费米子和拓扑量子态，涵盖 HgCdTe 体材料、HgTe 量子阱和 III-V 量子阱平台。
AI.motivation: 追溯从半导体纳米结构多体物理到拓扑量子物质的科学路径，建立独立研究计划：识别物理问题、发展预测理论，并与实验者共同开辟新方向。
AI.method: 以理论分析和预测建模为主，系统研究体材料 HgCdTe、单/双 HgTe 量子阱及三层 InAs/Ga(In)Sb 等异质结构，考察温度、压力、无序、电场和磁场等参数，并推动实验验证。
AI.result: 在 HgCdTe 中分析温度驱动带反转、畴壁态、交叉电场和磁场中朗道能级塌缩及无序诱导拓扑相变；在 HgTe 量子阱中揭示压力/温度/无序驱动相变、双层石墨烯样半金属及超越最小 BHZ 模型的 2D HOTI；提出 InAs/Ga(In)Sb 和 InAs_xSb_{1-x}/InAs_ySb_{1-y} 异质结构作为无质量狄拉克费米子、大带隙量子自旋霍尔绝缘体、2D HOTI 及二次能带接触半金属平台。部分预测获实验支持，包括高达60 K 的量子化螺旋边缘输运和非常规量子霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了闪锌矿半导体异质结构作为拓扑量子物质平台的潜力，并强调理论预测与实验合作的价值；HDR 于2026年3月25日在蒙彼利埃大学答辩。

title: Chern insulator optics
summary: Chern insulators have optical properties that are strikingly different than ordinary chiral media. Unlike the natural optical activity of the latter, which is a finite-wavelength effect arising from spatial dispersion, the optical activity of a Chern insulator is already present in the long-wavelength limit, and exhibits a striking directional asymmetry in the propagation of circularly polarized light. We study this unnatural optical activity using a recently developed field theory for Chern insulators. For bulk Chern insulators, we derive the normal-incidence transmission and reflection coefficients of multilayer structures, identify the associated Faraday and Kerr angles, and show that these optical rotations provide a direct optical signature of topology at low frequencies. We also show that an interface between bulk Chern insulators can act as a kind of mirror, completely reflecting light at normal incidence when the Chern invariants have opposite signs. Moving to a more realistic model of a two-dimensional current sheet, we study the Faraday and Kerr effects in a thin film of $\mathrm{Mn}\mathrm{Bi}_2\mathrm{Te}_4$ in its Chern insulator phase. The predicted rotations are many orders of magnitude larger than those of optically active media of comparable thickness that are topologically trivial.

AI.tldr: Chern绝缘体的光学活性不同于普通手性介质的自然光学活性：在长波极限已出现，且对圆偏振光传播有显著方向不对称性；本文用场论研究多层结构和MnBi₂Te₄薄膜的Faraday/Kerr效应，发现低频谱学旋转可作为拓扑的直接光学特征。
AI.motivation: 区分Chern绝缘体的“非自然”光学活性与由空间色散导致的自然光学活性，并寻找低频率下拓扑的光学探针。
AI.method: 采用近期发展的Chern绝缘体场论，推导体态多层结构正入射透射和反射系数，确定Faraday与Kerr角；分析两个Chern绝缘体界面；并对二维电流片模型及Chern绝缘体相MnBi₂Te₄薄膜的Faraday和Kerr效应进行计算。
AI.result: 体态Chern绝缘体的光学旋转提供低频拓扑光学特征；当两侧Chern不变量符号相反时，界面可像镜面一样在正入射下完全反射光；MnBi₂Te₄薄膜预测的Faraday/Kerr旋转比同厚度拓扑平庸光学活性介质大许多数量级。
AI.conclusion: Chern绝缘体具有巨大的拓扑光学活性，其Faraday/Kerr旋转和界面全反射效应可用于低频光学探测拓扑，并显著区别于普通手性介质。

title: Orientation-Dependent Universality of Spin-Transport Fluctuations in Two-Dimensional Altermagnets
summary: Universal conductance fluctuations are conventionally organized by symmetry class, but crystalline anisotropy introduces additional structure in spin transport. Here we demonstrate orientation-dependent universal spin-transport fluctuations in disordered two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnets without spin-orbit coupling. Rotating the altermagnetic orientation changes both longitudinal spin-conductance and transverse spin-Hall conductance fluctuations, while each conserved-spin sector remains in class AI. Altermagnetic orientation controls both the fluctuation amplitudes and the development of disorder-insensitive plateaus. These plateaus become flatter and less sensitive to the altermagnetic strength over the studied parameter ranges as the orientation approaches $45^\circ$, with representative fluctuation amplitudes of approximately $0.60e/(4\pi)$ for the longitudinal spin conductance and $0.40\,e/(4\pi)$ for the spin-Hall conductance. The longitudinal fluctuation amplitude correlates strongly with anisotropy of the clean-band Fermi-velocity tensor. Spin-sector covariances explain how the conserved channels combine into total fluctuations. Our results extend anisotropy-sensitive universal-fluctuation physics to conserved-spin altermagnetic transport and establish crystalline orientation as a control parameter within a fixed symmetry class.

AI.tldr: 在无自旋轨道耦合的二维d波交错磁体中，自旋输运的普适涨落随交错磁取向改变，尽管各守恒自旋扇区仍属AI类；取向可调控涨落幅度和抗无序平台。
AI.motivation: 传统普适电导涨落按对称类分类，但晶体各向异性如何影响自旋输运涨落尚不清楚；交错磁体提供无自旋轨道耦合下的自旋分裂与各向异性，因此需要研究取向是否能在固定对称类内调控涨落。
AI.method: 在无序二维d波交错磁体中计算自旋输运涨落，旋转交错磁取向，分别考察守恒自旋扇区的AI类行为、纵向自旋电导与横向自旋霍尔电导涨落、无序不敏感平台，并关联干净能带费米速度张量各向异性及自旋扇区协方差。
AI.result: 旋转取向同时改变纵向自旋电导和自旋霍尔电导涨落；各守恒自旋扇区仍为AI类。取向控制涨落幅度与平台形成；当取向趋近45°时平台更平、对交错磁强度更不敏感。代表性幅度约为0.60 e/(4π)（纵向自旋电导）和0.40 e/(4π)（自旋霍尔电导）。纵向涨落幅度与干净能带费米速度张量各向异性强相关；自旋扇区协方差解释守恒通道如何组合成总涨落。
AI.conclusion: 结果将各向异性敏感的普适涨落物理拓展到守恒自旋的交错磁输运，并确立晶体取向作为固定对称类内的调控参量。

title: Nonadiabatic dynamics under slow parametric modulation in nonlinear graphene resonators
summary: Resonantly driven nonlinear systems, from superconducting circuits to nanomechanical resonators, are often described in a rotating frame, where amplitude and phase evolve slowly within a fixed landscape of stable and unstable states. How such systems behave when this landscape moves on their intrinsic timescale remains to be understood. Here, we exploit the strong tension sensitivity of a graphene drum's resonance frequency to reshape the rotating-frame phase space of a bistable mechanical mode in real time, combining an MHz-frequency resonant drive with kHz-frequency tension modulation. When the modulation rate becomes comparable to the mechanical relaxation rate, adiabatic tracking of the fixed points breaks down. Instead, parametric instabilities emerge in the slow dynamics at frequencies set by libration around these points rather than by the mechanical resonance; stronger modulation drives period doubling and chaos. A slow-variable theory predicts where the instabilities occur, and Melnikov analysis captures the onset of chaos. These results show that the rotating frame itself can be parametrically driven, offering a general route to controlling nonadiabatic dynamics in systems ranging from Josephson bifurcation amplifiers to cold atoms.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过 kHz 张弦调制石墨烯鼓的 MHz 共振，实时重塑双稳机械模式的旋转框架相空间，揭示了非绝热参数不稳定性、倍周期与混沌，并证明旋转框架本身可被参数驱动。
AI.motivation: 共振驱动非线性系统通常用旋转框架描述，其中振幅与相位在固定稳定/不稳定态势能景观中缓慢演化；当该景观在系统内禀时间尺度上移动时，其行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用石墨烯鼓共振频率对张力的强敏感性，将 MHz 共振驱动与 kHz 张弦调制结合，实时移动双稳机械模式的旋转框架固定点；采用慢变量理论预测不稳定性，并用 Melnikov 分析判断混沌起始。
AI.result: 当调制速率接近机械弛豫率时，绝热跟踪固定点失效；慢动力学中出现参数不稳定性，其频率由固定点附近的 libration 决定而非机械共振。更强调制驱动倍周期并最终进入混沌；理论预测了不稳定性位置并捕捉混沌阈值。
AI.conclusion: 旋转框架本身可被参数驱动，这为控制从 Josephson 分岔放大器到冷原子等系统中的非绝热动力学提供了通用途径。

title: Magnetic field induced modulation of heat transport in CrPS$_4$ probed by TaIrTe$_4$ transverse Seebeck thermometry
summary: Understanding and controlling heat flow in low-dimensional magnetic materials is central to thermoelectrics and spin caloritronics. One of the challenges is the absence of sensitive probes of small, field-dependent modulations in thermal transport. Here we demonstrate transverse Seebeck thermometry using exfoliated TaIrTe$_4$ as a probe of thermal conductivity modulated by an external magnetic field on a van der Waals magnet, CrPS$_4$. With a temperature gradient oriented at $45^\circ$ to its principal crystallographic axes, TaIrTe$_4$ exhibits a transverse thermopower exceeding $200~\mathrm{\mu V\,K^{-1}}$ for 900 nm wide and 30 $\mu$m long electrodes, enabling precise detection of variations in the local temperature gradients. Exploiting this with CrPS$_4$ in a nonlocal geometry, we resolve distinct field dependent thermal conductivity changes associated with both the spin-flip and spin-flop magnetic transitions which we attribute to variations in the magnon$-$phonon coupling in CrPS$_4$. At 5 K, the transverse Seebeck response is modulated by more than 8$\%$ by an external magnetic field, demonstrating strong magnetic control of heat transport in CrPS$_4$. This all van der Waals platform offers high sensitivity to modulations of thermal conductivity and a broad adaptability to a wide range of exfoliated magnetic systems.

AI.tldr: 利用剥离的TaIrTe4横向塞贝克测温，在非局域范德华结构中高灵敏探测CrPS4的磁场调制热导，分辨自旋翻转与自旋倾斜转变，并在5 K下观测到横向塞贝克响应受磁场调制超过8%。
AI.motivation: 低维磁性材料中的热流理解与调控对热电学和自旋热电子学至关重要，但缺乏灵敏探测微小、磁场依赖的热输运调制的方法。
AI.method: 以温度梯度相对主晶轴成45°的剥离TaIrTe4作为横向热电探针，与范德华磁体CrPS4构成非局域器件，通过横向塞贝克电压检测局域温度梯度变化，从而表征CrPS4热导的磁场依赖性。
AI.result: TaIrTe4在900 nm宽、30 μm长电极下横向热电势超过200 μV/K，可精确分辨CrPS4中与自旋翻转和自旋倾斜磁转变相关的热导变化，并将其归因于磁子-声子耦合变化；5 K时横向塞贝克响应受外磁场调制超过8%。
AI.conclusion: 该全范德华平台对热导调制具有高灵敏度，并可广泛适配多种剥离磁性系统，为磁场控制热输运及自旋热电子学研究提供了有效手段。

title: Observation of correlations beyond the single-particle picture in fermionic counting statistics
summary: The analysis of charge fluctuations in a mesoscopic device can shed light on the fundamental question of whether or not a single-particle picture of electron transport is appropriate, even in the presence of Coulomb interaction. It has been shown on general grounds that mapping the interacting system onto a fermionic single-particle description is subject to strict constraints on the charge-transfer statistics. These constraints can be formulated in terms of a sign rule for the factorial cumulants of the full counting statistics. We report here on the experimental observation of a sign-rule violation in a most elementary model system, i.e. a single-level quantum dot, and provide theoretical modeling that can quantitatively reproduce the experimental data. This reveals the presence of correlations introduced by electron-electron interaction.

AI.tldr: 在单能级量子点中实验观测到全计数统计的阶乘累积量违反单粒子符号规则，并用理论模型定量复现，表明电子-电子相互作用引入了非单粒子关联。
AI.motivation: 研究存在库仑相互作用时，介观电子输运是否仍可用单粒子图像描述；单粒子费米子映射对电荷转移统计施加了严格的阶乘累积量符号规则，需要实验检验。
AI.method: 测量单能级量子点中电荷涨落的全计数统计及其阶乘累积量，并与考虑相互作用的量子点理论建模进行定量对比。
AI.result: 实验观察到阶乘累积量违反单粒子符号规则，且理论建模能够定量再现实验数据。
AI.conclusion: 符号规则破缺揭示了电子-电子相互作用导致的关联，说明该系统中简单的单粒子输运图像不成立。

title: Making Weak Interlayer Excitons Absorb: Manipulating the Effective Oscillator Strength via Purcell Engineering of Critical Coupling
summary: Interlayer excitons (IXs) in transition metal dichalcogenide bilayers possess unique dipolar properties, providing a path for exploring correlated many-body phases, electrically tunable dipole-dipole interactions, and long-range exciton transport. However, the large electron-hole separation underlying their dipolar character also results in a significantly reduced oscillator strength, limiting their direct optical interaction with light, and thus the direct probing of their dynamics and many-body interactions. Here, we show that by using Purcell engineering of critical coupling, a weak interlayer transition can absorb as strongly as the dominant intralayer transition, despite its much smaller intrinsic oscillator strength. Using this approach, in an open cavity architecture we demonstrate an order of magnitude IX absorption modulation in bilayer and trilayer MoS2, with doubling of the IX to A-exciton interaction strength weight from ~23% to ~53%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that in a tailored closed cavity architecture, the IX enhancement can reach beyond an order of magnitude, from ~5% to ~83% excitonic absorption, enabling IX absorption similar to intralayer excitons. An analytical description of the interaction is obtained via a closed-form transmission-line model which separates the excitonic and photonic contributions to the optical response, revealing how cavity architecture can be designed towards critical coupling. Our findings establish Purcell engineering of critical coupling as a general route to controlling and enhancing weak excitonic transitions.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用临界耦合的Purcell工程增强TMD双层/三层MoS2中本征振子强度很弱的层间激子（IX）吸收，使其吸收强度和与A激子的相互作用权重显著提升，并在闭腔结构中实现接近层内激子的IX吸收。
AI.motivation: 层间激子具有独特偶极性质，可用于关联多体相、电可调偶极-偶极相互作用和长程激子输运；但其电子-空穴分离导致振子强度低、光相互作用弱，难以直接探测其动力学和多体相互作用。因此需要一种方法来增强弱层间跃迁的光吸收和可探测性。
AI.method: 采用Purcell工程实现临界耦合，在开放腔结构中增强IX吸收，并在定制闭腔结构中进一步提升增强效果；同时建立闭式传输线模型，将光学响应中的激子贡献与光子贡献分离，以指导腔结构设计实现临界耦合。
AI.result: 在双层和三层MoS2开放腔中实现约一个数量级的IX吸收调制，IX与A激子相互作用强度权重从约23%提升至约53%；在定制闭腔中，IX增强超过一个数量级，激子吸收从约5%提升至约83%，使IX吸收可与层内激子相比。
AI.conclusion: 临界耦合的Purcell工程是一种控制和增强弱激子跃迁的通用途径，可用于提升层间激子的光学可及性并研究其动力学与多体相互作用。

title: Coherent and dissipative coupling of multiple photon-magnon hybrids in a chiral microwave resonator
summary: We demonstrate control between level repulsion and level attraction of photon-magnon coupling spectra in a chiral microwave-photon resonator loaded with a 2 mm YIG sphere. By systematically varying the coupling mode volume via the YIG position and the dc-field orientation, we tune the ratio between coherent and dissipative coupling strengths, $J/\Gamma$, and thereby switch between level repulsion and level attraction in the hybrid spectra. Full-wave electromagnetic and magnetization-dynamics simulations reveal multiple photon-magnon hybrid modes with distinct spatial overlap factors, which quantitatively account for gap sizes and their angular dependence. Strong nonreciprocity appears near $J/\Gamma \approx 1$, yielding 28.6 dB isolation ratio in agreement with a unified single-bath input-output model and full-wave simulations. Angular dependence of spectral characterization confirms a picture of the chirality-selection rule and our method of geometric tuning might be useful for considering reconfigurable on-chip isolators.

AI.tldr: 通过在加载2 mm YIG球的手性微波光子谐振器中调节YIG位置和直流磁场方向，改变相干与耗散耦合强度之比 J/Γ，实现光子-磁子谱在能级排斥与能级吸引之间切换，并在 J/Γ≈1 附近获得28.6 dB非互易隔离。
AI.motivation: 研究光子-磁子混合系统中相干耦合与耗散耦合的竞争和调控机制，并探索基于几何调节的可重构片上非互易器件。
AI.method: 使用手性微波-光子谐振器加载2 mm YIG球；通过改变YIG位置和dc磁场取向调节耦合模式体积，系统调控 J/Γ；结合全波电磁模拟、磁化动力学模拟以及统一单浴输入-输出模型进行分析。
AI.result: 实现了能级排斥与能级吸引的可控切换；模拟揭示多个具有不同空间重叠因子的光子-磁子混合模式，可定量解释带隙大小及其角度依赖；在 J/Γ≈1 附近出现强非互易性，隔离比达28.6 dB，与统一单浴输入-输出模型和全波模拟一致。
AI.conclusion: 角度依赖的谱学表征证实了手性选择定则；该几何调控方法有望用于可重构片上隔离器。

title: Designing Hamiltonians with Exactly Flat Higher-Vortexable Bands
summary: The zero modes of the Aharonov-Casher Hamiltonian form an exactly flat, vortexable Chern band in any nonuniform magnetic field, analogous to the lowest Landau level. We ask which local Hamiltonians host exactly flat higher-vortexable bands. For a scalar Hamiltonian, an exactly flat first-vortexable band requires a mass proportional to the local field; the Dirac analogue has the same structure. For periodic Bernal bilayer graphene with nonzero mean flux, the exact zero-mode pair is genuinely first-vortexable if and only if the interlayer hopping has nonzero mean; zero-mean hopping instead gives a decomposable pair. Multiorbital models yield exact higher-vortexable chains to arbitrary order, while remaining first order in momentum.

AI.tldr: 研究哪些局域哈密顿量能承载精确平的高阶涡旋可（vortexable）陈带：标量与狄拉克模型的一阶涡旋可平带要求质量正比于局域场；周期 Bernal 双层石墨烯零模对的真正一阶涡旋可性取决于层间跃迁是否有非零均值；多轨道模型可给出任意阶精确高阶涡旋可链。
AI.motivation: Aharonov-Casher 哈密顿量的零模在任意非均匀磁场中形成精确平、涡旋可的陈带，类似最低朗道能级。作者由此追问：哪些局域哈密顿量能承载精确平的高阶涡旋可带。
AI.method: 通过解析分析标量哈密顿量与狄拉克对应体，推导精确平一阶涡旋可带对质量项和局域场的条件；考察周期 Bernal 双层石墨烯在非零平均磁通下的零模对，判断其是否真正一阶涡旋可或仅为可分解零模对；进一步用多轨道模型构造精确高阶涡旋可链。
AI.result: 标量哈密顿量要实现精确平的一阶涡旋可带，质量必须正比于局域场，狄拉克情形结构相同。周期 Bernal 双层石墨烯在非零平均磁通下，精确零模对真正一阶涡旋可当且仅当层间跃迁具有非零均值；若层间跃迁均值为零，则得到可分解的零模对。多轨道模型可产生任意阶精确高阶涡旋可链，同时在动量上仍保持一阶。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了精确平高阶涡旋可陈带的构造条件与模型机制，将 Aharonov-Casher 零模/最低朗道能级类比推广到高阶涡旋可性，并指出层间跃迁均值和多轨道结构在区分与实现此类平带中的关键作用。

title: Orbitronics in Zero-dimensional Graphene Nanoflakes via Electrode Coupling
summary: We show that graphene nanoflakes realize a previously unexplored form of orbitronics in which orbital currents emerge in the absence of intrinsic angular momentum of the constituent atoms. Starting with a hexagonal graphene nanoflake, we demonstrate the presence of energy-degenerate eigenstates with opposite non-zero expectation values of the angular momentum. Placing electrodes in an appropriate configuration on the flake couples the reservoirs more strongly to one of the two opposite-angular-momentum states, yielding a chiral current that carries a net orbital angular momentum. The resulting circulating orbital currents generate magnetic fringe fields that are experimentally accessible with spin centers or superconducting quantum interference magnetometers, providing avenues for their experimental realization. Finally, our work establishes a new platform for exploring and studying orbitronics in zero-dimensional systems.

AI.tldr: 石墨烯纳米片可实现一种无需原子内禀角动量的轨道电子学：通过电极构型选择性耦合相反角动量的简并态，产生携带净轨道角动量的手性轨道电流，并产生可探测的磁边缘场。
AI.motivation: 探索不依赖原子内禀角动量的轨道流，并在零维系统中建立轨道电子学研究平台。
AI.method: 以六方石墨烯纳米片为体系，识别具有相反非零角动量期望值的能量简并本征态；在薄片上布置适当电极，使电极储层更强耦合到其中一个角动量态，从而驱动手性电流并携带净轨道角动量；分析其产生的磁边缘场及实验探测方案。
AI.result: 实现了石墨烯纳米片中的轨道流：相反角动量简并态被选择性耦合，形成净轨道角动量手性电流；该循环轨道电流产生磁边缘场，可通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁强计探测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在零维系统中探索和研究轨道电子学提供了新平台，并给出了实验实现的可能途径。

title: Landau quantization of $C_3$ high-fold fermions in honeycomb lattices
summary: We present the theory of the Landau levels of $C_3$ high-fold fermions in honeycomb lattices. These fermions arise as a generalization of the tight-binding model in a honeycomb lattice with one orbital per site, known to describe graphene, to a family of models with several orbitals per site transforming according to representations of $C_3$, relevant for triangulene two-dimensional crystals. The models are defined by the number of orbitals $n_a$ and $n_b$ at the $a$ and $b$ sites of the unit cell. They feature energy bands that combine flat bands and Dirac cones, that are isomorphic to those of graphene, the Lieb, $p_{xy}$ honeycomb, and the Kagome tight-binding models. Combining tight-binding and $k\cdot p$ methods, here we compute the Landau levels of the $(1,1)$, $(1,2)$, $(2,2)$ and $(3,3)$ models, we compare them to those of the reference models, and we explore the similarities and differences with the Landau levels in graphene. Our findings reveal that the nature of $C_3$ high-fold fermions combine Dirac-type Landau quantization, originating from the linear crossings and associated relativistic band dispersion, with anomalous Landau quantization rooted in the quantum geometry of the singular flat bands.

AI.tldr: 本文建立蜂窝晶格中 C3 高简并费米子的朗道能级理论，揭示其兼具源于线性狄拉克色散的常规朗道量子化和源于奇异平带量子几何的异常朗道量子化。
AI.motivation: 将石墨烯单轨道蜂窝紧束缚模型推广到每格点含多个按 C3 表示变换的轨道，以描述三角烯二维晶体等体系，并厘清其高简并费米子能带与朗道能级的性质。
AI.method: 模型由原胞 a、b 位点轨道数 (n_a,n_b) 定义；结合紧束缚与 k·p 方法，计算 (1,1)、(1,2)、(2,2)、(3,3) 模型的朗道能级，并与石墨烯、Lieb、p_xy 蜂窝和 Kagome 等参考模型比较。
AI.result: 这些模型的能带由平带和狄拉克锥组成，并与石墨烯、Lieb、p_xy 蜂窝及 Kagome 紧束缚模型同构；所算朗道能级既呈现狄拉克型量子化，也表现出与奇异平带量子几何相关的异常量子化，与石墨烯有相似也有差异。
AI.conclusion: C3 高简并费米子的本质是线性交叉/相对论色散导致的狄拉克型朗道量子化与奇异平带量子几何导致的异常朗道量子化的结合。

title: Odd-to-Even-Layer Switch of Spontaneous Excitonic State in $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$ Thin Films
summary: $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$ is a candidate of high temperature excitonic condensates with spontaneous exciton formation in addition to its charge density wave (CDW). However, direct observation and manipulation of this electron-hole paring state formation is still lacking. Here, using varying-temperature angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (VT-ARPES), we observe a distinct odd-to-even-layer switch of spontaneous exciton state formation with the evident correlated band structure in $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$ thin films. While the odd-layer $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$ films show a sharp band structure in single-particle picture superimposed by CDW renormalization, in the even-layer $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$ films, the full-filling valence band (VB) opens a distinct notch at the top, and the conductive band (CB) shows a significant extra signal extending above Fermi level with spectra broadening. These features indicate that the extra holes (notched VB) and electrons (broadening CB above Fermi level) form spontaneous excitons in even-layer $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$. Based on a correlated electron-hole model extracted from the tight-binding description, we reproduce the characterized band structures with spontaneous exciton formation, where the interlayer inter-band coupling in $\rm{TiSe_{2}}$ plays a key role, which leads to an odd-to-even-layer switch of the excitonic state formation. Our results provide direct evidences of the spontaneous exciton formation, promising an excitonic condensate as versatile platform for realizing Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) and investigating novel correlated phenomena.

AI.tldr: 利用变温角分辨光电子能谱（VT-ARPES）在TiSe2薄膜中观察到自发激子态形成随奇偶层数切换，并结合紧束缚关联电子-空穴模型揭示了层间带间耦合的关键作用。
AI.motivation: TiSe2被认为是高温激子凝聚的候选体系，可在电荷密度波（CDW）之外发生自发激子形成，但此前缺乏对该电子-空穴配对态形成的直接观测与调控。
AI.method: 采用变温角分辨光电子能谱（VT-ARPES）测量TiSe2薄膜的关联能带结构，并基于紧束缚描述构建关联电子-空穴模型，以复现实验能带特征。
AI.result: 奇数层TiSe2薄膜表现为单粒子图像下的清晰能带并叠加CDW重整化；偶数层薄膜中满占据价带顶部出现明显缺口，导带在费米能级以上出现显著额外信号并伴随谱展宽，表明额外空穴与电子形成自发激子。模型成功复现这些特征，并表明层间带间耦合是导致激子态形成发生奇偶层切换的关键。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了自发激子形成的直接证据，表明激子凝聚体可作为实现玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）及研究新奇关联现象的多功能平台。

title: Pressure engineering of the excitonic moir\'e-potential landscape and exciton-charge interplay in semiconductor moir\'e superlattices
summary: Semiconductor moir\'e superlattices, owing to strongly bound excitons and pronounced electronic correlation, have emerged as an intriguing solid platform for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena, where the moir\'e potential landscape plays a central role. Hydrostatic pressure allows continuous, in-situ tuning of this landscape, but remains underexplored because of experimental challenges. Here we integrate a diamond anvil pressure cell with high quality dual gated WSe2/WS2 twisted bilayers and perform cryogenic optical spectroscopy. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moir\'e intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moir\'e-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. Moreover, we demonstrate efficient pressure control over the interplay between charges and both intralayer and interlayer excitons: the intralayer charge-transfer exciton becomes less sensitive to doping, likely due to reduced charge-transfer character; in contrast, the interlayer exciton exhibits enhanced exciton-charge repulsion. Our results establish hydrostatic pressure as a powerful tuning knob for engineering bosonic quasiparticles and Bose-Fermi interactions in moir\'e materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作将金刚石压砧与高质量双栅 WSe2/WS2 扭转双层结合，通过低温光谱证明静水压可显著调控莫尔激子势景观及激子-电荷相互作用。
AI.motivation: 半导体莫尔超晶格是研究关联玻色子现象的重要平台，其中莫尔势景观至关重要；但静水压虽可原位连续调控该景观，却因实验挑战而研究不足。
AI.method: 集成金刚石压砧压力池与高质量双栅 WSe2/WS2 扭转双层，并进行低温光学光谱测量。
AI.result: 观察到莫尔层内激子随压力的不同演化，揭示激子莫尔势景观被剧烈调制，并由连续模型描述，暗示可工程化激子能带拓扑；同时实现压力对电荷与层内、层间激子相互作用的有效控制：层内电荷转移激子对掺杂不敏感，可能源于电荷转移特征减弱；层间激子则表现出增强的激子-电荷排斥。
AI.conclusion: 静水压可作为调控莫尔材料中玻色准粒子和 Bose-Fermi 相互作用的强有力手段。

title: Magnetic proximity beyond the interface: Layer-sequence-dependent exchange in WSe$_2$/CrI$_3$ heterostructures
summary: Magnetic proximity effects in transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD)/2D-magnet heterostructures are often described in terms of the magnetization of the interfacial magnetic layer. Here, we show that this picture is sufficient to describe the neutral-exciton valley splitting of the TMD, but incomplete for its hole-doped electronic structure. We study a gate-tunable van der Waals heterostructure composed of monolayer WSe$_2$ in direct contact with trilayer CrI$_3$. By combining spatially and helicity-resolved reflection-contrast spectroscopy with magnetic circular dichroism, we identify two distinct magnetic domains in the trilayer CrI$_3$: one with purely antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling and one with a mixed antiferromagnetic (AFM)/ferromagnetic~(FM) coupling. In both domains, the sign of the neutral-exciton valley splitting of WSe$_2$ switches with the magnetization reversal of the adjacent CrI$_3$ layer. In contrast, helicity-resolved positive-trion spectroscopy of WSe$_2$ reveals a qualitatively different response. While the AFM domain shows a strongly helicity-selective trion resonance, the mixed AFM/FM domain exhibits trion resonances in both helicities. This behavior disappears when all CrI$_3$ layers are aligned in a parallel magnetization direction. Our results demonstrate that charged excitons are sensitive to the full layer-resolved magnetic sequence of the adjacent 2D-magnet, revealing magnetic proximity beyond the interface.

AI.tldr: 在 WSe2/三层 CrI3 异质结中，中性激子谷劈裂可由界面层磁化描述，而正三激子响应则反映出整个 CrI3 的层分辨磁序，表明磁近邻效应超越界面。
AI.motivation: 传统上 TMD/2D 磁体异质结的磁近邻效应常仅用界面磁性层的磁化来解释，但该图像是否足以描述掺杂电子结构尚不明确。
AI.method: 制备栅压可调的 WSe2/三层 CrI3 范德华异质结，结合空间与螺旋分辨反射对比光谱及磁圆二色性，分别测量中性激子和正三激子的谷劈裂与螺旋选择性。
AI.result: 在三层 CrI3 中识别出纯反铁磁层间耦合区和混合反铁磁/铁磁耦合区；两区中性激子谷劈裂符号均随相邻 CrI3 磁化反转而翻转。正三激子则不同：AFM 区呈强螺旋选择性三激子共振，混合 AFM/FM 区在两种螺旋下均出现三激子共振；当所有 CrI3 层平行磁化后该行为消失。
AI.conclusion: 带电激子对相邻 2D 磁体的完整层分辨磁序敏感，而中性激子主要感知界面层；因此磁近邻效应不能仅由界面磁化描述，而是可深入探测 2D 磁体的层间磁结构。

title: Andreev-reflection spectroscopy of SrPt3P single crystals
summary: The interplay between inversion symmetry breaking and superconducting pairing mechanisms is a long-standing puzzle of solid-state physics. Ternary platinum phosphide SrPt$_3$P is an excellent case study in this regard, since it shares the distorted anti-perovskite crystal structure of non-centrosymmetric superconductor CePt$_3$Si but preserves the inversion symmetry center, enabling a direct comparison between the two compounds. Despite intense scrutiny, the superconducting pairing strength, gap symmetry, and magnitude of SrPt$_3$P remain an open question. Here, we study the gap structure of high-quality SrPt$_3$P single crystals with $T_c = 8.6$ K by using point-contact Andreev-reflection spectroscopy. The spectra systematically showed symmetric conductance maxima and a zero-bias minimum, as is typical of fully gapped superconductors, and dips at finite voltage $V_\mathrm{dip}$ due to the local transition of the contact region to the resistive state. In contacts with high resistance, where the dips fall sufficiently far from the gap features, the conductance curves can be well fitted with a single isotropic $s$-wave gap. The temperature dependence $\Delta(T)$ of the gap amplitude extracted from the fit is in good agreement with the one predicted by the BCS theory, with a zero-temperature mean value $\Delta(0)=1.88\pm0.08$ meV, and a mean gap ratio $2\Delta/k_\mathrm{B}T_c = 5.2\pm0.2$.

AI.tldr: 利用点接触Andreev反射谱研究高质量SrPt3P单晶，发现其具有全能隙、各向同性s波超导配对，能隙温度依赖符合BCS，零温能隙约1.88 meV，2Δ/kBTc约5.2。
AI.motivation: 反演对称破缺与超导配对机制之间的关系是凝聚态物理长期难题。SrPt3P与non-centrosymmetric超导体CePt3Si共享畸变反钙钛矿结构，但保留反演对称中心，因此可作为直接对照体系；然而其配对强度、能隙对称性和能隙大小仍未确定。
AI.method: 采用点接触Andreev反射谱测量Tc=8.6 K的高质量SrPt3P单晶；分析电导谱，并在高阻接触中使有限电压dip远离能隙特征，再用单各向同性s波能隙模型拟合。
AI.result: 谱中观察到对称电导极大和零偏压极小，以及有限电压Vdip处的dip。高阻接触数据可由单一各向同性s波能隙良好拟合；拟合得到的Δ(T)与BCS理论一致，Δ(0)=1.88±0.08 meV，平均能隙比2Δ/kBTc=5.2±0.2。
AI.conclusion: SrPt3P表现为全能隙、各向同性s波配对，能隙温度依赖符合BCS；较大的2Δ/kBTc值暗示强耦合特征。该结果有助于通过与CePt3Si对比理解反演对称性对超导配对机制的影响。

title: Anyons at impurities: Fractional charge measurement and "wrong sign" binding
summary: Recent photoluminescence experiments in twisted MoTe$_2$ have reported signatures of anyons binding to trapped trions. The measured binding energies near the fractional Chern insulators at fillings of $\nu=-2/3$ and $-3/5$ have a ratio close to the fractional-charge ratio $5/3$, even though such scaling is not generally guaranteed for the expected short-range trion-anyon interaction. We model the trapped trion as a fixed impurity, and investigate anyon-impurity binding using a lowest-Landau-level model with exact diagonalization and Jain wavefunctions. Surprisingly, we find that the anyon-impurity binding energy ratio between $\nu=-2/3$ and $-3/5$ is close to $5/3$ for either short- or long-ranged impurity-electron interactions. However, the ratio departs strongly from the charge ratio at intermediate ranges or different Jain states. Remarkably, we also uncover "wrong-sign" binding, whereby both quasiholes and quasiparticles can bind to either sign of a short-range impurity potential by selecting orbital channels with favorable local density oscillations. Our findings show that localized excitons or trions can be used to probe the internal density profile of anyons.

AI.tldr: 在扭曲 MoTe₂ 中，被困激子/三子与分数陈绝缘体中的任意子结合，其结合能比可近似反映任意子分数电荷，但该比例依赖相互作用程长与 Jain 态。
AI.motivation: 近期光致发光实验在填充 ν=-2/3 与 -3/5 附近观测到任意子束缚于被俘获三子的信号，且结合能比接近分数电荷比 5/3；然而对短程三子-任意子相互作用，这种标度并非普遍保证，需澄清其机制。
AI.method: 将俘获三子建模为固定杂质，在最低朗道能级框架下研究任意子-杂质束缚，结合精确对角化与 Jain 波函数，并比较短程、长程及中等程长的杂质-电子相互作用。
AI.result: 发现 ν=-2/3 与 -3/5 的任意子-杂质结合能比在短程或长程相互作用下都可接近 5/3，但在中等程长或不同 Jain 态下会显著偏离电荷比；还揭示了“反号”束缚：准空穴与准粒子均可束缚于任意符号的短程杂质势，通过选择具有有利局域密度振荡的轨道通道实现。
AI.conclusion: 局域激子或三子可作为探测任意子内部密度分布的探针，其结合能标度和反号束缚行为为理解分数陈绝缘体中的任意子性质提供了新途径。

title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moir\'e graphene
summary: Unconventional superconductivity can emerge in various forms in strongly correlated systems. Historically, the most extensively studied examples include nodal and triplet pairing, which were experimentally detected in cuprates and superfluid helium-3, respectively. Beyond these canonical cases, there are also nematic superconductors, in which the rotational symmetry of the lattice is broken in the superconducting state. While there are several examples of nematic superconductors whose pairing emerges inside a preexisting nematic normal state, experimental evidence for superconducting states that intrinsically break rotational symmetry on their own has been exceedingly scarce. Here, we report the experimental realization and identification of an intrinsic multi-component nodal nematic superconducting state in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (MATTG). By integrating tunneling spectroscopy with quantum transport measurements, we directly probe the symmetry of low-energy superconducting quasiparticles. Deep inside the superconducting state, we observe a pronounced two-fold anisotropy in the zero-bias tunneling conductance under an in-plane magnetic field, which is strongly suppressed together with superconductivity as the temperature or perpendicular magnetic field is increased. Remarkably, the major axis of anisotropy rotates by up to $90^{\circ}$ across the superconducting dome, indicating an intrinsic, field- and density-tunable symmetry of the low-energy excitations. These behaviors imply a nodal superconducting state in MATTG that spontaneously breaks the six-fold rotational symmetry of the moir\'e superlattice. Our results establish moir\'e graphene as a versatile platform for realizing and interrogating nodal nematic superconductivity, opening a new avenue for exploring unconventional symmetry-breaking superconducting states in two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 在魔角转角三层石墨烯中，通过隧道谱与量子输运测量发现一种本征的多分量节点向列超导态，其低能准粒子表现出可随磁场和密度调控的两重各向异性。
AI.motivation: 非常规超导已在铜氧化物和超流氦-3等体系中表现为节点配对或三重配对，而向列超导通常源于已存在的向列正常态；超导态本身自发破坏旋转对称性的实验证据仍极其稀缺。
AI.method: 以魔角转角三层石墨烯为平台，结合隧穿谱与量子输运测量，直接探测低能超导准粒子的对称性；在深超导态下施加面内磁场，测量零偏压隧穿电导的各向异性，并改变温度、垂直磁场和载流子密度。
AI.result: 观察到零偏压隧穿电导在面内磁场下出现显著两重各向异性，且随温度或垂直磁场增大与超导一同被抑制；各向异性主轴在超导穹顶内可旋转达90°，表明其低能激发具有本征、可由场和密度调控的对称性，并暗示MATTG中节点超导态自发破坏莫尔超晶格的六重旋转对称性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了莫尔石墨烯作为实现和研究节点向列超导性的通用平台，为探索二维材料中非常规对称破缺超导态开辟了新途径。

title: Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System for extrapolative prediction of perovskite solar cells
summary: Existing machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells struggle to predict devices made from new materials. Most treat device layers as arbitrary categorical labels and represent perovskite absorbers either through featureless composition vectors or through rigid crystal graphs that require a pre-solved unit cell. As a result, they cannot generalize to unrecorded alloys or unfamiliar cell architectures. We present the Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System (V-PaSS), an architecture built around the physical continuity of perovskite solid solutions. V-PaSS represents arbitrary mixed-cation, mixed-halide absorbers by interpolating relaxed crystal graphs of 23 pure $ABX_3$ endpoint compounds via Vegard's law with learned bandgap bowing. For the device stack, it couples layer sequence and cell polarity (n-i-p or p-i-n) with interfacial band offsets and encodes chemical descriptions with a scientific language model. Evaluated under an institution-grouped protocol where test devices come exclusively from unseen laboratories, an untuned default configuration of V-PaSS achieves the lowest error among fourteen tested models (2.861% MAE, a 5.2% relative reduction over a gradient-boosted baseline at 3.017%, and outperforming the best tuned benchmark at 2.912%). V-PaSS pulls furthest ahead where test devices differ most from training: reducing error by 15.7-19.0% on unseen absorber alloys, by 16.1% on mixed absorbers from new laboratories, and widening its lead over the baseline by 3.6$\times$ on devices with unobserved transport layers. Combined with tree ensembles, V-PaSS sets a new state of the art across all five benchmark splits.

AI.tldr: V-PaSS 通过钙钛矿固溶体物理连续性插值纯端元晶体图，并耦合器件堆叠、极性、界面能带偏移与科学语言模型，在未见实验室测试下显著提升钙钛矿太阳能电池性能预测泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习模型难以预测新材料器件：将器件层视为任意类别标签，吸收层用无特征组分向量或需预先求解晶胞的刚性晶体图表示，导致无法泛化到未记录合金或不熟悉电池结构。
AI.method: 提出 Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System（V-PaSS）。对任意混合阳离子、混合卤素吸收层，依据 Vegard 定律和学习型带隙弯曲效应，插值 23 种纯 ABX3 端元化合物的弛豫晶体图；器件层面耦合层序和电池极性（n-i-p 或 p-i-n）与界面能带偏移，并用科学语言模型编码化学描述。评估采用按机构分组协议，测试器件全部来自未见实验室。
AI.result: 未调优默认配置在 14 个模型中误差最低：MAE 2.861%，较梯度提升基线 3.017% 相对降低 5.2%，并优于最佳调优基准 2.912%。在测试与训练差异最大处优势更明显：未见吸收合金误差降低 15.7–19.0%，新实验室混合吸收层降低 16.1%，未观测传输层器件上对基线领先扩大 3.6 倍。与树集成结合后，在全部五个基准划分上达到新 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: V-PaSS 利用钙钛矿固溶体物理连续性和器件语义信息，显著改善对未见材料、实验室和器件结构的泛化预测；与树集成结合可在多个基准上刷新最优结果。

title: Electron-Mediated Phonon Polaritons in Quantum Cavities
summary: Phonon-photon coupling in quantum materials is commonly treated as an effective direct interaction, neglecting the crucial role played by electrons. Here we develop a gauge-invariant theory of cavity phonon polaritons that captures electronic screening, dissipation, and hybridization. We show that screening can suppress polariton formation in metals, severely constraining cavity control of phonon-mediated superconductivity. By contrast, interband electronic resonances in time-reversal-symmetric gapped systems can strongly enhance phonon-photon coupling, enabling robust polariton formation down to the monolayer limit despite electronic absorption. We illustrate these effects in NbSe2, hBN, and gapped graphene. Finally, we show that gauge invariance enforces photon decoupling from a critical soft phonon, establishing a general no-go mechanism for photon condensation.

AI.tldr: 本文建立包含电子屏蔽、耗散与杂化的规范不变腔声子极化激元理论，表明金属中屏蔽会抑制极化激元并限制腔场调控声子介导超导，而时间反演对称的带隙体系中带间电子共振可增强声子-光子耦合，支持单层极限下的稳健极化激元；规范不变性还禁止光子与临界软声子耦合，给出光子凝聚的一般no-go机制。
AI.motivation: 常规将声子-光子耦合视为有效直接相互作用，忽略电子的关键作用；需澄清电子屏蔽、耗散和杂化如何影响腔声子极化激元，及其对腔调控超导与光子凝聚的意义。
AI.method: 发展规范不变的腔声子极化激元理论，纳入电子屏蔽、耗散和杂化；以NbSe2、hBN和有能隙石墨烯为例说明。
AI.result: 金属中的电子屏蔽可抑制极化激元形成，严重限制腔场对声子介导超导的调控。相反，时间反演对称的带隙体系中带间电子共振可强烈增强声子-光子耦合，即使存在电子吸收，也能在单层极限下形成稳健极化激元。规范不变性要求光子与临界软声子解耦，从而建立光子凝聚的一般no-go机制。
AI.conclusion: 电子自由度对腔声子极化激元至关重要；极化激元形成和腔效应强烈依赖材料电子结构：金属受屏蔽抑制，带隙且具带间共振的体系可增强；规范不变性排除了通过临界软声子实现光子凝聚的途径。

title: Engineering Correlated Transparent Conductors via Metal-Insulator Transition Proximity
summary: Transparent conductors are key functional materials in modern optoelectronic devices. Their performance is governed by an inherent trade-off between optical transparency and electrical conductivity. Correlated metallic oxides offer an attractive workaround to this compromise, where narrow partially-filled bands provide high conductivity, while the absence of visible-range transitions enables optical transparency. Despite this promise, transparency and conductivity remain coupled through carrier density and electronic coherence. Here, we use proximity to a metal-insulator transition (MIT) as a design principle for engineering this balance in correlated-oxide transparent conductors. Epitaxial Ti-substituted $SrVO_3$ films serve as a model platform where the optical window and metallicity are tuned simultaneously. We demonstrate and explain a systematic broadening of the optical window to regimes relevant for silicon photovoltaics. This gain is counterbalanced by carrier depletion and disorder, which drive the loss of coherent transport near the composition-driven MIT. A Haacke figure-of-merit analysis identifies the optimal composition range near the MIT, where the loss of metallic transport is accompanied by persistent near-Fermi-level spectral weight, indicating disorder-assisted localization together with correlation-driven spectral-weight redistribution. These findings establish proximity to an MIT as a general materials-design strategy, using electronic filling as a tuning knob for the transparency-conductivity balance in correlated-oxide transparent conductors.

AI.tldr: 该文提出以金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）邻近性为设计原则，在关联氧化物透明导体中解耦并优化透明性与导电性，并以Ti取代SrVO3外延薄膜验证。
AI.motivation: 透明导体是光电器件关键材料，但其光学透明性与电导率存在内在权衡；关联金属氧化物可通过窄部分填充带和可见光区无跃迁提供高导电与透明，但透明性和导电性仍受载流子密度与电子相干性耦合，需要新的材料设计策略。
AI.method: 以MIT邻近性为设计原则，制备外延Ti取代SrVO3薄膜作为模型平台，同时调控光学窗口与金属性；结合输运、光学谱和Haacke品质因子分析，研究成分驱动MIT附近透明-导电平衡及近费米能级谱权演化。
AI.result: Ti取代使光学窗口系统性展宽至硅光伏相关范围，但增益被载流子耗尽和无序抵消，并在成分驱动MIT附近导致相干输运丧失；Haacke品质因子确定MIT附近最优成分区间，此时金属输运损失伴随持续近费米能级谱权，表明无序辅助局域化与关联驱动谱权重再分布共存。
AI.conclusion: MIT邻近性可作为通用材料设计策略，利用电子填充度作为调节旋钮，在关联氧化物透明导体中平衡透明性与导电性。

title: Symmetry-selected extreme shear compliance in a stable carbon monolayer
summary: Solids that are stiff to most loads and extremely compliant to one are normally built, not found. That internal atomic relaxation lowers elastic constants is textbook; what has remained untested is whether it can be driven far enough to separate the elastic scales of a crystal by an order of magnitude while leaving it mechanically stable. Density functional theory calculations of the complete in-plane elastic tensor of four non-hexagonal carbon monolayers sharing a square lattice metric show that it can: their longitudinal stiffnesses agree to within a factor of two while their shear constants span more than a factor of fifty. Twin T-graphene, previously reported as elastically isotropic from normal strains alone, is the extreme case, with $C_{66}=3.03$~N\,m$^{-1}$, nearly fifty times below graphene, at an axial stiffness typical of semiconducting monolayers, and a soft Kelvin eigenvalue a factor of $29$ below the others while the Born criteria hold. Symmetry confines the strain-induced relaxation to the $B_{2g}$ sector, a counter-torsion of the carbon sublayers about the short mid-plane bonds that removes $96\%$ of the clamped-ion shear stiffness with almost no bond stretching and leaves the semiconducting gap intact. Transverse acoustic phonons, finite-temperature dynamics, and large-deformation simulations show that the channel survives beyond the harmonic, zero-temperature limit. Because the selection rule is a point-group statement rather than a chemical one, it yields a screening criterion for other crystals and other strain components.

AI.tldr: 通过DFT计算四类方形晶格碳单层，发现Twin T-graphene可在保持力学稳定的同时将面内剪切刚度降至极低，从而把弹性尺度分离超过一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 常规材料通常需人工设计才能对某一载荷极软；原子弛豫虽已知会降低弹性常数，但能否在晶体中将其驱动到使不同弹性尺度相差一个数量级且仍满足稳定性，此前未验证。
AI.method: 用密度泛函理论计算四类共享方形晶格度规的非六方碳单层的完整面内弹性张量，并辅以横向声子、有限温度分子动力学和大变形模拟检验。
AI.result: 四种单层纵向刚度相差仅约2倍，但剪切常数跨度超过50倍；Twin T-graphene的C66=3.03 N/m，比石墨烯低近50倍，轴向刚度与典型半导体单层相当，软Kelvin本征值比其余体系低29倍且满足Born判据。对称性将应变诱导弛豫限制在B2g扇区，即碳亚层围绕短中间面键的反向扭转，去除96%钳位离子剪切刚度而几乎不拉伸键，并保持半导体带隙。横向声子、有限温度动力学和大变形模拟表明该通道在非谐、有限温度下仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 该机制源于点群选择定则而非特定化学组成，因此可作为筛选其他晶体和其他应变分量的准则，用于寻找极端各向异性或单轴柔性晶体。

title: Atomic ironing for conformal interfaces in freestanding oxide nanomembranes
summary: Atomically well-defined interfaces are essential for realizing functional interlayer coupling in stacked and twisted oxide heterostructures, yet transferred freestanding oxides can develop structural inhomogeneities, including local curvatures, interfacial voids, and incomplete contacts with substrates. Here, we demonstrate that these transfer-induced structural disorders and imperfections evolve substantially and can be suppressed by post-transfer thermal treatments, yielding bulk-like crystalline freestanding oxide nanomembranes. Using freestanding SrTiO3 membranes as a model system, we report a systematic understanding of the role of "atomic ironing" and the associated evolution of lattice mosaicity, interfacial roughness, and optical bandgap. We further demonstrate atomically bonded conformal interfaces in twisted SrTiO3 heterostructures, highlighting the importance of post-transfer thermal processes. These results establish a synthetic strategy to restore the structural integrity and intrinsic bulk-like functionality of freestanding oxide nanomembranes, enabling stacked, twisted, and heterogeneously integrated oxide architectures with atomically well-defined interfaces for emerging quantum functionalities.

AI.tldr: 后转移热处理可“原子熨平”自由支撑氧化物纳米膜，消除转移引起的结构缺陷，获得类块体结晶性和原子级共形界面。
AI.motivation: 堆叠与扭转氧化物异质结需要原子级明确界面以实现功能性层间耦合，但转移后的自由支撑氧化物常出现局部弯曲、界面空洞和与衬底接触不完全等结构不均匀性。
AI.method: 以自由支撑SrTiO3纳米膜为模型体系，采用后转移热处理，系统研究“原子熨平”作用及晶格马赛克度、界面粗糙度和光学带隙的演变；并在扭转SrTiO3异质结中构建原子键合共形界面。
AI.result: 转移诱导的结构无序会显著演化，并可通过后转移热处理被抑制，从而获得类块体结晶的自由支撑氧化物纳米膜；在扭转SrTiO3异质结中实现了原子级键合的共形界面。
AI.conclusion: 后转移热处理是一种恢复自由支撑氧化物纳米膜结构完整性和本征类块体功能的有效合成策略，可推动具有原子级明确界面的堆叠、扭转及异质集成氧化物架构，用于新兴量子功能。

title: ActMOF: Mapping Reticular Synthesis through Active Learning
summary: Reticular chemistry allows metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) to be designed from their building units, yet their synthesis remains constrained by sparse experimental data, noisy crystallization outcomes, and the absence of benchmarks for comparing active-learning strategies. While data-driven approaches such as Bayesian optimization (BO) can improve synthesis success rates, selecting appropriate optimizers beforehand for mapping MOF crystallization landscapes remains largely empirical. Here we present ActMOF, an experiment-grounded benchmark for comparing search strategies in aluminum-carboxylate MOF synthesis. ActMOF is emulated from experimentally measured microwave syntheses with each encoded condition assigned a crystallinity index calculated based on diffraction peak intensity and full width at half-maximum. By benchmarking policies guided by Gaussian processes (GP), tree ensembles and large language models (LLM), ActMOF placed the GP family among the leading policies for active learning in sparse synthesis landscapes. It then demonstrated transferability by guiding the microwave synthesis of six reticularly related aluminum MOFs. All six campaigns gave crystalline products within a fixed budget of 12 experiments each, and established a reusable testbed for AI-driven MOF synthesis.

AI.tldr: ActMOF 是一个基于实验的铝羧酸 MOF 合成主动学习基准：利用微波合成数据、结晶度指数和多种优化策略比较，发现高斯过程（GP）族表现领先，并在六种网状相关 MOF 上实现每个 12 次实验内获得结晶产物。
AI.motivation: MOF 合成受稀疏实验数据、结晶结果噪声和缺乏主动学习策略基准制约；尽管贝叶斯优化（BO）可提高合成成功率，但预先选择合适优化器以映射 MOF 结晶景观仍主要依赖经验。
AI.method: 从实验测量的微波合成构建 ActMOF，对每个编码条件基于衍射峰强度和半高宽（FWHM）分配结晶度指数；基准测试由高斯过程（GP）、树集成和大型语言模型（LLM）引导的策略，并迁移用于六种网状相关铝 MOF 的微波合成。
AI.result: GP 族在稀疏合成景观的主动学习中位列领先策略；六个迁移合成 campaign 均在固定 12 次实验预算内得到结晶产物，并建立了可复用的 AI 驱动 MOF 合成测试平台。
AI.conclusion: ActMOF 为 AI 驱动 MOF 合成提供了可复用、可迁移的基准，表明在稀疏数据条件下 GP 类主动学习策略具有优势，并支持系统比较和选择优化策略。

title: Error-controlled switching between discrete and continuum dislocations in a unified defect framework
summary: Simulating defects of every dimension together is expensive, and the savings of adaptive methods are rarely tested at equal accuracy. We present a variational framework in which fields, dislocation lines and defect densities share one free energy, one dissipation law and exact ledgers of mass and Burgers vector, so that a region can change its representation without gaining or losing defects. On this basis, an allocator switches the dislocations themselves between discrete particles, where they are sparse, and a continuous density, where they are dense. The switch is made block by block from local counts, conserves the Burgers vector exactly and is controlled by a single threshold. For $5\times10^5$ dislocations, the allocator reproduces the discrete model to within 1% in the sparse region at 14-37 times lower cost, depending on the machine; the advantage grows to 81 times at $10^6$ dislocations, and a threshold calibrated on one ensemble meets its error target on an independent one. For an idealized array of dislocation walls in copper, the allocator is 37.5 times cheaper than particle dislocation dynamics and, at almost the same cost, six times more accurate than continuum dislocation dynamics between the walls. In a three-dimensional copper model coupling grain-boundary cavitation with damage, ligaments left at nominal coalescence delay creep rupture by 25-48% (post hoc sweep). By contrast, grids refined at interfaces gain less than twofold once the active region exceeds about 30% of the domain, so representation switching, rather than grid refinement, is the effective form of adaptivity for defect-rich microstructures.

AI.tldr: 提出一种变分自适应框架，在同一自由能、耗散律及质量与Burgers矢量精确守恒下，按块在离散位错粒子与连续位错密度之间切换表示，实现缺陷丰富微结构的高效高精度模拟。
AI.motivation: 同时模拟各维度缺陷代价高昂，而自适应方法的节省很少在同等精度下得到验证；需要一种在区域改变表示时不增益或丢失缺陷的方法。
AI.method: 构建统一变分框架，使场、位错线和缺陷密度共享一个自由能、一个耗散律，并保持质量和Burgers矢量精确账本；分配器根据局部计数逐块切换：稀疏区用离散位错粒子，密集区用连续位错密度，单阈值控制且Burgers矢量精确守恒。
AI.result: 对5×10^5个位错，稀疏区以14–37倍更低成本将离散模型复现到1%以内，10^6个位错时优势达81倍，且在一个系综上校准的阈值可在独立系综上达到误差目标。铜中理想位错墙阵列：比粒子位错动力学便宜37.5倍，并在几乎相同成本下，墙间精度比连续位错动力学高6倍。三维铜晶界空化与损伤耦合模型中，名义合并处的韧带使蠕变断裂延迟25–48%（事后扫描）。当活跃区超过约30%区域后，界面细化网格增益不足2倍。
AI.conclusion: 对于缺陷富集微结构，表示切换而非网格细化，是更有效的自适应形式。

title: Nonadiabatic polaron dynamics from machine-learned hopping trajectories
summary: The formation and motion of small polarons are ubiquitous in energy materials and influence photoinduced processes. Polaron transport is governed by thermally activated lattice dynamics and rare hopping events, requiring spatial and temporal scales only attainable with machine-learning molecular dynamics, which enables extensive sampling of atomic trajectories and polaron configurations over nanoseconds. Moreover, the Born-Oppenheimer approximation underlying standard ab initio molecular dynamics cannot describe the nonadiabatic coupling between electronic states mediated by nuclear motion, which controls energy exchange and excited-state relaxation. Here, we develop a simulation framework that combines machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics with nonadiabatic molecular dynamics to bridge these complementary aspects of polaron physics, and determine how different polaron-hopping mechanisms affect excited-state dynamics. The enlarged trajectory space allows us to provide the first direct dynamical confirmation of the adiabatic or nonadiabatic classification of polaron hopping regimes originally proposed on the basis of static Marcus-theory arguments, and to connect individual hopping events directly to nonadiabatic electronic transitions. In bulk TiO$_2$, nonadiabatic hoppings occur preferentially when the energy of the polaron-induced gap state approaches the conduction-band manifold, promoting both electronic de-excitation and, via a Landau-Zener mechanism, excitation from the ground state. In MgO, the predominantly adiabatic character of hole-polaron hopping suppresses these effects, leading to longer charge-carrier lifetimes and an absence of thermally activated excitations. At the rutile TiO$_2$(110) surface, hopping events are rarer than in bulk because the excess electron is strongly stabilized in the subsurface region, leading to correspondingly longer de-excitation times.

AI.tldr: 该工作结合机器学习辅助的极化子动力学与非绝热分子动力学，在纳秒尺度上模拟小极化子的跳跃及其激发态电子动力学，并首次直接验证了基于马库斯理论的极化子跳跃绝热/非绝热分类。
AI.motivation: 小极化子的形成与运动广泛存在于能源材料中并影响光诱导过程；其输运由热激活晶格动力学和稀有跳跃事件控制，需要机器学习分子动力学才能达到足够时空尺度。同时，标准从头算分子动力学中的玻恩-奥本海默近似无法描述核运动介导的非绝热电子态耦合，而该耦合控制能量交换和激发态弛豫，因此需要统一极化子动力学与非绝热分子动力学。
AI.method: 作者开发了一个模拟框架，将机器学习辅助的极化子动力学与非绝热分子动力学相结合，以桥接极化子物理中互补的方面，并研究不同极化子跳跃机制如何影响激发态动力学。
AI.result: 扩大的轨迹空间使作者首次直接动力学确认了原先基于静态马库斯理论论证的极化子跳跃绝热/非绝热分类，并将单次跳跃事件直接关联到非绝热电子跃迁。在块体TiO2中，非绝热跳跃优先发生在极化子诱导的带隙态能量接近导带多能级时，促进电子去激发，并通过Landau-Zener机制引起基态激发。在MgO中，空穴极化子跳跃以绝热为主，抑制上述效应，导致更长的载流子寿命且无热激活激发。在rutile TiO2(110)表面，由于额外电子在亚表面区域被强烈稳定，跳跃事件比块体更稀少，导致去激发时间相应更长。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将机器学习辅助极化子动力学与非绝热分子动力学相结合，为极化子跳跃机制及其对激发态动力学的影响提供了直接动力学证据，并揭示了不同材料中绝热/非绝热跳跃差异如何决定电子去激发、载流子寿命和热激活激发行为。

title: A practical route to amorphous solid-state electrolyte structures by hybrid reverse Monte Carlo with foundation potentials
summary: Amorphous alkali oxychlorides are fast ion conductors, but their atomic structure remains unresolved. Total scattering sums all partial pair correlations into one curve that has no unique inversion, so the structure must be modeled. Melt-quench molecular dynamics builds a model from the interatomic potential alone, and reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) builds one from the measurement alone. The two have rarely been compared with all else held fixed. We benchmark both routes and two hybrid schemes on amorphous \ce{Li_{0.9}NbO_{0.9}Cl_{4.1}} against one neutron pair distribution function with one foundation potential. The hybrid schemes put the energy either in the acceptance rule (inline) or in short relaxations between blocks of refinement (alternating). Each refinement starts from a melt-quench glass or from a random packing of isolated units. The glass has the lowest energy and places the first-shell peaks correctly, but carries almost none of the oscillation beyond 6~\AA{} (goodness of fit $R^{2} = 0.29$). Pure RMC fits the measurement to within its counting noise ($R^{2} = 0.99$), but at more than $1.3$~eV/atom above the glass, and niobium loses about half of its first-shell chlorine. Started from the glass, both hybrid schemes reach $R^{2} = 0.92$ within $0.1$~eV/atom of its energy and keep its coordination chemistry. Structures from the two inputs fit almost equally well and differ in energy by a tenth of the RMC penalty, yet they differ in whether their polyhedra are connected. The input is therefore part of the method. We recommend quenching a glass with a foundation potential and refining it against the measurement with a hybrid scheme. The resulting structure carries both the local chemistry and the medium-range order, and it is the starting point for modeling ion transport in these conductors.

AI.tldr: 论文比较了熔融淬火分子动力学、纯RMC及两种混合建模方案在非晶Li0.9NbO0.9Cl4.1上的表现，指出输入结构是方法的一部分，推荐用基础势淬火得到玻璃态再以混合方案对测量数据进行精修。
AI.motivation: 非晶碱金属氧氯化物是快离子导体，但其原子结构未解；总散射只给出一条无唯一反演的全偏对相关曲线，因此必须建模，而仅靠势能或仅靠测量的建模路线尚缺乏固定其他条件后的系统比较。
AI.method: 以同一中子对分布函数和同一基础势为基准，在非晶Li0.9NbO0.9Cl4.1上比较熔融淬火分子动力学、纯RMC以及两种混合方案：inline将能量放入接受规则，alternating在精修块之间进行短弛豫；每种精修分别从熔融淬火玻璃或孤立单元随机堆积出发。
AI.result: 熔融淬火玻璃能量最低并能正确给出第一壳层峰，但6 Å以外振荡几乎缺失（R²=0.29）；纯RMC可在计数噪声内拟合测量（R²=0.99），但能量比玻璃高逾1.3 eV/atom，且Nb约失去一半第一壳层Cl。从玻璃出发的两种混合方案达到R²=0.92，能量仅在玻璃上方0.1 eV/atom内，并保留配位化学；两种输入所得结构拟合几乎同样好，能量相差为RMC惩罚的十分之一，但多面体是否连接不同。
AI.conclusion: 输入结构应被视为方法的一部分；建议先用基础势淬火得到玻璃态，再用混合方案对测量数据精修。所得结构同时保留局域化学与中程有序，可作为模拟这些导体中离子输运的起点。

title: Transverse magneto-gyrotropy driven by spin-induced ferroaxiality
summary: Photon chirality is inherently sensitive to structural handedness and magnetism, which break spatial inversion and time-reversal symmetries, respectively. Ferroaxial order, by contrast, hosts two-dimensional chirality while preserving both symmetries, thereby precluding its direct coupling to photon chirality. Intertwining ferroaxiality with magnetic order, however, may lift such constraints and enable unconventional coupling to photon chirality. Nevertheless, the optical response arising from such intertwined order has yet to be demonstrated experimentally. Here, we demonstrate transverse magneto-gyrotropy arising from spin-driven ferroaxiality in the Weyl magnet EuCd2Sb2. Whereas the conventional polar magneto-optical Kerr effect is governed by magnetization parallel to the light-propagation direction, we observe a gyrotropic response associated with magnetization transverse to the light-propagation direction. The optical rotation exhibits a characteristic 120-degree periodicity upon rotation of the in-plane magnetic field, reflecting the threefold symmetry of the emergent ferroaxial state and revealing the ferroaxial origin of the transverse gyrotropic response. This coupling to photon chirality enables vectorial control of the gyrotropic response through the magnetic field direction. Our findings establish an interaction between photon chirality and transverse magnetization enabled by intertwined ferroaxial and magnetic orders, demonstrating a novel form of multiferroicity with functional light-matter interaction.

AI.tldr: 在Weyl磁体EuCd2Sb2中观测到由自旋驱动铁轴序产生的横向磁旋光（transverse magneto-gyrotropy），其光学旋转随面内磁场方向呈120°周期，源于 emergent ferroaxial state 的三重对称性。
AI.motivation: 光子手性通常对破坏空间反演的结构手性和破坏时间反演的铁磁序敏感；铁轴序虽具有二维手性，但保持空间反演与时间反演对称性，因而不能直接耦合光子手性。将铁轴序与磁序交织可能解除限制并实现非常规光子手性耦合，但此前缺乏实验证明。
AI.method: 在Weyl磁体EuCd2Sb2中进行磁光偏振测量，施加并旋转面内磁场，测量光学旋转/磁旋光响应，以区分纵向磁化主导的常规极向磁光Kerr效应与横向磁化相关的gyrotropic响应。
AI.result: 观测到与光传播方向横向磁化相关的横向磁旋光响应；光学旋转随面内磁场旋转呈现120°周期，反映涌现铁轴态的三重对称性，表明该横向gyrotropic响应源于铁轴序。该耦合使gyrotropic响应可通过磁场方向进行矢量调控。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了由铁轴序与磁序交织所实现的光子手性与横向磁化之间的相互作用，展示了一种具有功能性光-物质相互作用的新型多铁性。

title: Sorption Molecular Dynamics of Point Defects in 2D Materials with a Machine Learning Potential
summary: Defect engineering is a crucial tool for tuning and tailoring the properties of two-dimensional (2D) materials. A key challenge is identifying which defects are kinetically stable at room temperature and sufficiently promising to warrant further investigation. However, identifying stable defects with suitable properties using first-principles calculations, such as density functional theory (DFT) is computationally demanding, effectively limiting the scope of high-throughput studies. In this work, we investigate whether the machine learning interatomic potential MACE can reproduce sorption trends (adsorption vs. absorption) previously obtained from high-throughput DFT calculations and extend the analysis to elevated temperatures. A total of 17,624 defect structures from the ADAQ database are simulated using MACE-accelerated molecular dynamics (MD) at both 0 K and 300 K. The results show that MACE successfully reproduces the overall sorption trends observed in DFT calculations at 0 K at a fraction of the computational cost. Simulations performed at 300 K further indicate that the qualitative sorption trends remain largely the same when including finite-temperature effects. These findings demonstrate that MACE-driven MD can be used as an effective high-throughput prescreening tool for defect-related studies in 2D materials, specially related to sorption. While conventional first-principles methods, such as DFT, remain necessary for accurate and quantitative validation, the use of MLIPs enables MD simulations of finite-temperature defect behavior at a fraction of the computational cost of DFT-based MD.

AI.tldr: MACE机器学习原子间势可加速分子动力学，在极低成本下复现二维材料缺陷的吸着趋势，并在300 K下保持定性一致，适合作为缺陷相关研究的高通量预筛选工具。
AI.motivation: 缺陷工程是调控二维材料性质的关键，但利用DFT识别室温动力学稳定且性能有前景的缺陷计算成本极高，限制了高通量筛选；因此需要评估机器学习原子间势能否复现DFT的吸着趋势并扩展到有限温度。
AI.method: 使用MACE势加速分子动力学，对ADAQ数据库中17,624个缺陷结构在0 K和300 K进行模拟，比较吸附与吸收趋势，并与先前高通量DFT计算结果对照。
AI.result: MACE在0 K成功复现DFT得到的总体吸着趋势，且计算成本显著降低；300 K模拟表明，考虑有限温度效应后，定性吸着趋势基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: MACE驱动的MD可作为二维材料缺陷研究尤其是吸着相关研究的高通量预筛选工具；DFT仍需要用于准确和定量验证，但机器学习原子间势使有限温度缺陷行为的MD模拟成本远低于基于DFT的MD。

title: Identification of carbon-related color centers in hBN by high-resolution ab initio photoluminescence modeling
summary: Identification of optically active defects in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) remains challenging because different defect candidates can produce similar calculated photoluminescence (PL) lineshapes. Here, we demonstrate that force-constant embedding methodology can be extended to calculate high-resolution, vibrationally resolved PL lineshapes in the polar layered material hBN. Benchmarking against the carbon dimer defect, responsible for the 4.1 eV emission, we show that the methodology accurately reproduces the low-energy acoustic phonons and fine spectral features that are inaccessible when using direct supercell calculations. Applying the methodology to neutral carbon trimers ($\mathrm{C_2 C_B}$ and $\mathrm{C_2 C_N}$), we find that the calculated PL lineshape and excitation energy of $\mathrm{C_2 C_N}$ closely match the low-temperature spectrum of the emitter with a zero-phonon line at 1.54 eV. These results establish high-resolution phonon-sideband modeling as a powerful tool for discriminating among candidate defects in polar materials.

AI.tldr: 该工作将力常数嵌入方法扩展至极性层状hBN，用于高分辨率振动分辨PL线形计算，并据此区分候选缺陷，发现C2CN与1.54 eV零声子线发射体高度吻合。
AI.motivation: hBN中光学活性缺陷的识别困难，因为不同缺陷候选可给出相似的计算PL线形，需要更高分辨率的振动精细结构来区分。
AI.method: 扩展力常数嵌入方法，在极性层状hBN中计算高分辨率、振动分辨的PL线形；以负责4.1 eV发射的碳二聚体缺陷为基准，并与直接超胞计算对比；进一步应用于中性碳三聚体C2CB和C2CN。
AI.result: 该方法准确重现了低声学声子和直接超胞计算无法获得的精细光谱特征；C2CN的计算PL线形和激发能与零声子线位于1.54 eV的低温发射谱高度匹配。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率声子边带建模是区分极性材料中候选缺陷的有力工具。

title: Access Rate-Dependent Endurance Behavior of Ferroelectric Hafnium Zirconium Oxide Capacitors
summary: Fluorite-structured ferroelectrics, such as hafnium zirconium oxide ($Hf_{1-x}Zr_{x}O_{2}$), are among the most promising materials for developing the next generation of low-power nonvolatile memories. Emulating realistic operating scenarios for ferroelectric memories requires performing access rate-dependent endurance tests.
